page.title: Inbox categories
page.description: Split inboxes into tabs like Primary, Updates and Newsletters. New mail is sorted as it arrives, and nothing leaves the inbox.

privacy: Admins choose the categories, never see anyone's mail or how it was sorted. Everyone can turn off Ollie's sorting for their own accounts.

editor.primaryHint: Primary is always first: mail from people, and anything Ollie is unsure of
editor.name: Name
editor.primaryDescription: Mail from people, and anything that fits nowhere else

problem.name: Every category needs a name of up to 40 characters.
problem.repeat: Two categories have the same name.

suggest.aboutPlaceholder: For example: sales for a design studio, with clients, leads and invoices
suggest.hint: Optional. Ollie proposes a set you can change before saving.
suggest.accountHint: Optional. Ollie also looks at the senders and subjects of this inbox's latest mail.
suggest.empty: Ollie had nothing to suggest. Try a few words about the inbox.

workspace.title: Workspace default
workspace.description: Everyone's accounts follow these, unless their team has its own or they choose their own.
workspace.enabledOn: New mail is sorted into these tabs as it arrives.
workspace.enabledOff: Inboxes stay one list. Members who may choose their own can still split theirs.
workspace.categoriesHint: Primary always comes first. Each description tells Ollie what belongs there.
workspace.chooseOn: Members can pick their own categories, or none, for the accounts they manage.
workspace.chooseOff: Everyone follows the workspace or their team. Members can still turn off Ollie's sorting for their accounts.
workspace.sortingAi: Ollie sorts new mail as it arrives, by each category's description. Mail Ollie is unsure of stays in Primary.
workspace.sortingRules: Sorted by sender rules and mail headers.
workspace.sortingRulesHint: Turn on AI to let Ollie sort.
workspace.saved: Categories saved. Mail is being sorted again.
workspace.removeText: Accounts that follow the workspace go back to one inbox. Whoever manages one is offered a guided set-up instead.

empty.title: Split everyone's inbox
empty.description: Set categories once for the whole workspace, like Gmail's tabs: mail from people stays in Primary, and updates, newsletters and promotions get tabs of their own.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: A team can have its own categories, which its members' accounts follow instead of the workspace's.
teams.empty: No team has its own categories
teams.emptyHint: Every team follows the workspace default.
teams.order: Someone in several teams gets the first team's categories. Drag to change the order.
teams.enabledOff: This team's inboxes stay one list, whatever the workspace sets.
teams.removeText: Its members' accounts follow the workspace default again.

member.locked: Your admins set categories for everyone. You can still turn off Ollie's sorting for your accounts.
member.free: You can choose your own for each account you manage.
member.accountsHint: Change an account's categories and sender rules in its settings.
member.emptyDescription: Your workspace has not set inbox categories. You can split your own inbox from each account's settings.

section.title: Inbox categories
section.description: Split this inbox into tabs like Primary, Updates and Newsletters. New mail is sorted as it arrives, and nothing leaves the inbox.
section.locked: Your workspace's admins set the categories. You can still choose whether Ollie sorts this account's mail.
section.followHintNone: No default yet, so the inbox stays one list until your admins set one.
section.followHintOff: Turned off for now, so the inbox stays one list.
section.customHint: Categories of your own for this account.
section.offHint: Everything stays in one inbox, whatever the workspace sets.
section.aiHint: Ollie reads the sender, subject and first lines of new mail to pick its tab. When off, only sender rules and mail headers sort it.
section.aiUnavailable: AI is off for the workspace, so rules and headers sort it for now.
section.saved: Categories saved. Mail is being sorted again.

rules.title: Sender rules
rules.hint: Mail from these senders always goes to their tab. Adding a rule moves the sender's mail in the inbox now.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Moving a conversation to a tab also offers "Always for this sender".
rules.invalid: Enter an address, or @ and a domain.

setup.title: Split your inbox
setup.description: Tabs for {{account}}: mail from people stays in Primary, and updates, newsletters and the rest get tabs of their own as they arrive.
setup.ollieHint: Ollie looks at the senders and subjects of this inbox's latest mail and proposes tabs.
setup.scratchHint: Primary and one category of your own.
setup.step2Hint: Rename, recolour and reorder them. The descriptions tell Ollie what belongs where.
setup.saved: Your inbox is split. New mail is sorted as it arrives.
setup.everyone: Set it up for everyone instead
setup.locked: Your workspace's admins set the categories for everyone. Ask an admin to change them.
